summary: This note is a short encyclopedic biography of Jean Lannes, a Marshal of the Empire under Napoleon, covering his titles and dates of life and death. It highlights his reputation as one of Napoleon's most daring and talented generals, including Napoleon's remark that he found Lannes a pygmy and left him a giant. It also notes his close personal friendship with the emperor, which allowed him to use the informal 'tu' form of address.
one_line: Biography of Jean Lannes, Napoleonic Marshal of the Empire and celebrated daring general who was a personal friend of Napoleon.
key_facts: Jean Lannes was also known as 1st Duc de Montebello and Prince de Siewierz.
Jean Lannes was born on 10 April 1769 and died on 31 May 1809.
Jean Lannes was a Marshal of the Empire.
Jean Lannes was one of Napoleon's most daring and talented generals.
Napoleon commented on Jean Lannes: "I found him a pygmy and left him a giant".
Jean Lannes was a personal friend of the emperor Napoleon.
Because of his friendship with the emperor, Jean Lannes was allowed to address Napoleon with the familiar "tu" rather than the formal "vous".
